requirements.label: C
requirements.title: Methodology Requirement
requirements.sourceText: Majors must demonstrate competence in appropriate social science methodology by passing POL 201 - Introduction to Statistical Methods in Political Science with a grade of C or higher. We will accept the following equivalent courses for POL 201: AMS 102, AMS 110, BIO 211, BUS 215, ECO 320, PSY 201, or SOC 202. A course taken to fulfill the methodology requirement may not count toward fulfilling any other major requirement.

requirements.label: D
requirements.title: Upper-Division Writing Requirement (0 credits)
requirements.sourceText: Political science majors can meet the upper division writing requirement by completing POL 459.

requirements.label: Note 2
requirements.title: Satisfactory/Unsatisfactory credit limit

rule.text: No more than six credits of courses with Satisfactory/Unsatisfactory grading may be applied to the major.
rule.reason: Program-wide credit cap across all major requirements; no rule type covers it.

policies.sourceText: All courses taken to fulfill major requirements must be passed with a letter grade of C or higher, except for those with a Satisfactory/Unsatisfactory grading scale which must be passed with an S.
Majors must demonstrate competence in appropriate social science methodology by passing POL 201 - Introduction to Statistical Methods in Political Science with a grade of C or higher.

notes.text: Discuss the program with the Director of Undergraduate Studies (Dr. Michael Peress, michael.peress@stonybrook.edu) or the Undergraduate Program Coordinator (Ashley Porcello). Students should fulfill the methodology requirement no later than the beginning of the junior year.
Concentration courses marked with * are crosslisted with another academic department; credit is earned by registering for either course but not both.
POL 475 and POL 476 may not be used toward the major. Transfer courses must have a grade of C or higher to be accepted toward the major.

Students may apply for the Political Science honors program with a 3.70 GPA in political science courses and a 3.40 cumulative GPA, through POL 495 and POL 496 Senior Honors Project in Political Science.

The Fast-Track BA/MA in Public Policy is a five-year program for eligible declared majors (60 credits completed, 3.0 minimum GPA, one or two courses remaining in the electives area and/or the American Government, Law, and Public Policy concentration). It is not evaluated here.
Students completing the Stony Brook Curriculum must complete a course satisfying the WRTD learning objective (for example POL 368 or POL 459) to graduate.
